data.title: After orbital mechanics class
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Did you finish problem set four? Speaker 2: Halfway. The Hohmann transfer part is killing me. Speaker 1: Want to work through it together Wednesday night in the library? Speaker 2: Yes, Wednesday at seven works. I'm Dan, by the way. Speaker 1: Amara. Also, did you see there's a registration hold on your account? Mine had one for the lab fee. Speaker 2: No, I didn't. I'll email Professor Lindqvist about it tomorrow so I can register for spring. Speaker 1: The set is due Friday at noon, don't forget.

contact.name: Amara
contact.context: Classmate in an orbital mechanics course; talked after class about the problem set.
